title: Microsoft Clipchamp: Copilot video creation in Video Hub, billed in Copilot Credits
summary: The briefing's rollout, billing, prerequisites and preview limits are supported by Microsoft's notice and documentation. The control paths stop early, and the licensing administrator role needs a caveat because Microsoft's setup page gives conflicting permissions.

claims.claim: Copilot brings agentic video creation to Clipchamp Video Hub.
claims.quote: Copilot brings agentic video creation to Clipchamp Video Hub.

claims.claim: Users can describe the topic, audience, tone and length in a prompt.
claims.quote: Create from a prompt. Describe the topic, audience, tone and length, or pick a starter prompt.

claims.claim: Users can base videos on Word, PowerPoint, images, video or PDF from OneDrive.
claims.quote: Add a Word document, PowerPoint presentation, images, video or PDF from OneDrive, or draw on relevant work context through Work IQ.

claims.quote: Ask for changes like "Use a more formal tone", "Make it shorter", "Localize this into Japanese" or "Update the title."

claims.claim: The usage-based billing overview lists Clipchamp: Copilot video creation as a managed service.
claims.quote: | Clipchamp: Copilot video creation | How to create a video with Copilot |

claims.claim: The cited Clipchamp features page does not describe this video creation feature.
claims.quote: Searched: read learn.microsoft.com/clipchamp/features-clipchamp in full; searched 'Clipchamp Video Hub' 'default' Copilot and Clipchamp Copilot video creation. The features page describes recording and playback, not this agentic preview.

claims.claim: A single default state for this feature on arrival is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Clipchamp Video Hub' 'default' Copilot; Clipchamp Copilot video creation default automatically enabled spending policies. Read roadmap, MC1560920, billing setup/management and Anthropic pages: prerequisites and conditional automatic coverage, not a feature-wide default.

claims.claim: Videos only draw on work content the user already has permission to access.
claims.quote: Videos only draw on work content the user already has access to.

claims.where: Why it matters; Open questions; rationale: risk; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Auto-apply new services automatically adds newly supported services to a spending policy when enabled.
claims.quote: When the setting is on, newly supported Microsoft Copilot services and agents are automatically added to the policy.

claims.claim: Claude models are on by default for most commercial-cloud customers outside EU/EFTA and UK.
claims.quote: Microsoft enables Claude models on by default for most customers in commercial cloud (excluding EU/EFTA and UK).

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends confirming Anthropic access and updating spending policies before enabling the capability.
claims.quote: If you plan to enable this capability, confirm Anthropic models are enabled and update Copilot Credits spending policies to include Copilot video creation with Clipchamp for intended users.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends reviewing internal readiness guidance for administrators and support teams before broader enablement.
claims.quote: Review internal readiness guidance for admins and support teams before broader enablement.

claims.claim: The supplied notice does not explain how other sensitivity-label settings apply.
claims.quote: Searched: read MC1560920 in full for sensitivity labels, label settings and governance. Its label statement addresses viewing and downloading videos from documents labelled above General, not other label settings.

claims.claim: Claude models deployed in Microsoft offerings such as Microsoft Copilot are currently excluded from the EU Data Boundary.
claims.quote: Claude models deployed in Microsoft offerings such as Microsoft Copilot, Researcher, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Copilot in Microsoft 365 apps are currently excluded from the EU Data Boundary

claims.claim: Customers within the EU Data Boundary and in the UK have Claude models disabled by default.
claims.quote: Customers within the EU Data Boundary and customers in the UK have Claude models disabled by default.

claims.claim: AI Administrator or Global Administrator can configure the Anthropic subprocessor setting.
claims.quote: You must be a member of the AI Administrator or Global Administrator role to perform this task.

claims.claim: Anthropic provider access can be restricted to individual users or Microsoft Entra security groups.
claims.quote: You can restrict user access to AI provider subprocessors by assigning permissions to specific users or Microsoft Entra ID security groups in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.claim: Identity-based spending policies can scope service access to users or groups.
claims.quote: Use this option when you need to manage usage by users or groups for a supported service.

claims.claim: Global administrator and Billing administrator can add, select and change billing methods.
claims.quote: Global administrator and Billing administrator roles can add, select, and change billing methods, and set billing methods in policies.

claims.claim: AI administrator can edit spending policies but cannot create them.
claims.quote: AI administrator and License administrator roles can edit spending policies, manage limits and alerts, and billing methods. However, they can't create spending policies.

claims.claim: License administrator can edit spending policies but cannot create them.
claims.quote: AI administrator and License administrator roles can edit spending policies ... However, they can't create spending policies. / AI Reader, Global Reader, License Administrator, and other supported reader-based roles ... provide read-only access
claims.fix: Remove License administrator from the controls[0] note and the Security & identity sentence about editing policies. The cited setup page both permits License administrator edits and lists License Administrator among read-only roles, so it does not give consistent guidance for that role.

claims.claim: The notice describes no action that runs without the user.
claims.quote: Searched: read MC1560920 in full for autonomous actions and background execution. It describes user prompts, conversational refinements, previews and an explicit Export selection, with no autonomous workflow.

claims.quote: Cowork (Copilot license required) / Advanced work in SharePoint (Copilot license required) / Clipchamp: Copilot video creation

claims.claim: A limited monthly policy budget limits the credits that policy can spend each month.
claims.quote: Limited monthly budget: When you select a limited monthly budget, you limit the number of credits that this policy can spend each month.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; Open questions; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Auto-apply new services is selected by default for spending policies.
claims.quote: By default, the Auto-apply new services toggle is selected for spending policies.

claims.claim: Claude models are unavailable to federal GCC customers and all GCC High and DoD customers.
claims.quote: Claude models aren't available for federal customers in GCC or for any customers in GCC High and Department of Defense (DoD) environments.

claims.claim: Specific users must be represented through security groups in spending policies.
claims.quote: At this time, you can only support specific users and resource accounts through security groups.

claims.claim: The spending-policy path is Copilot > Cost Management > Configuration > + Add spending policy > Define the policy scope > Identity > Select agents and services.
claims.quote: Select the Configuration tab and then select + Add spending policy. / Define the policy scope / choose Identity as the scope. / Select agents and services / Set limits and alerts
claims.fix: Extend controls[0].ui.path and the rendered table path to 'Copilot > Cost Management > Configuration > + Add spending policy > Define the policy scope > Identity > Select agents and services > Set limits and alerts'. The printed route reaches service selection but stops before the row's credit limits.

claims.claim: PATCH /beta/copilot/costManagement/spendingPolicies/{id} updates spending limits through periodLimit and perUserLimit.
claims.quote: PATCH /copilot/costManagement/spendingPolicies/{id} / The following properties can be updated: displayName, periodLimit, perUserLimit, and billingMethods. / PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/costManagement/spendingPolicies/

claims.claim: The Anthropic access path is Copilot > Settings > View all > AI providers operating as Microsoft subprocessors > Anthropic.
claims.quote: under Available subprocessors for your organization, select Anthropic, and Save. / Under Choose who can access Anthropic models for Copilot and generative AI experiences, select your users or groups and Save.
claims.fix: Set controls[1].ui.path and the rendered path to 'Copilot > Settings > View all > AI providers operating as Microsoft subprocessors > Available subprocessors for your organization > Anthropic > Choose who can access Anthropic models for Copilot and generative AI experiences'. The source gives the omitted heading and the user/group access section.

claims.claim: An API or automation operation for the Anthropic provider-access setting is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Graph Anthropic AI providers operating as Microsoft subprocessors access users groups API settings; site:learn.microsoft.com/graph 'Anthropic' settings. Opened connect-to-ai-subprocessor and copilot-ai-provider-user-sec-group-access; only portal configuration found.

claims.claim: Anthropic assignments operate at provider level across Copilot experiences, rather than only for video creation.
claims.quote: These assignments are applied at the provider level and enforced across Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio experiences.

claims.claim: Global administrator or Billing administrator can create spending policies.
claims.quote: This section covers the initial setup steps ... creating the first spending policy. / Sign in ... with one of the following administrator roles: Global administrator; Billing administrator

claims.claim: Spending policies are limit-based controls, not reservations or allocations of Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: Spending policies are limit-based controls and don't reserve or allocate Copilot Credits to users or groups.

claims.claim: The cited update call covers limits and billing, not service selection; its listed updatable properties are displayName, periodLimit, perUserLimit and billingMethods.
claims.quote: In the request body, supply only the values for the properties to update. The following properties can be updated: displayName, periodLimit, perUserLimit, and billingMethods.

claims.claim: The Graph operation is a beta API subject to change.
claims.quote: APIs under the /beta version are subject to change. Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported.

claims.claim: The notice says exported videos carry a Made with AI watermark that administrators can turn off.
claims.quote: Exported videos carry a "Made with AI" watermark, which admins can turn off.

claims.claim: Learn documents a visual watermark policy for AI-generated video in Microsoft 365 and explicitly includes Clipchamp-generated video.
claims.quote: A policy setting controls your organization's ability to add a visual or audio watermark to video and audio content that your users generate or alter by using AI in Microsoft 365. / A visual watermark is added to a video generated with Clipchamp.

claims.claim: The Include a watermark when content from Microsoft 365 is generated or altered by AI policy is available only in Cloud Policy service for Microsoft 365.
claims.quote: This policy is available only in Cloud Policy service for Microsoft 365.

claims.claim: Learn says the watermark policy must be Enabled for a visual or audio watermark to be added.
claims.quote: If you want to add a watermark to video and audio content, you need to set this policy to Enabled. If you set this policy to Disabled or Not configured, a visual or audio watermark isn't added.
